source_text: Qui primo adsciiti sunt ceciderunt propter perseverantiam delictorum. Numerus prior peccatis cassatur.
pass_a_gloss: Who first enrolled are fell because-of perseverance of-faults. Number prior by-sins is-voided.
pass_b_english: Those first enrolled [[fell through persistence in sin >> Bible:Numbers 14:29-35]]. The former count is voided by faults.
